title: INTO THE SUNSET - Sunseeker 88 Yacht
highlights: Beach club with tender garage and Seabob storage
description:
INTO THE SUNSET is a 2024 Sunseeker 88 Yacht with Sunseeker warranty through August 2026 and a transferable five-year Brunswick Passport Premier coverage. Twin MTU 96X engines give a top speed of 28 knots.

She accommodates eight guests in four cabins, with a tender garage and beach club, a new ABJET 465 XP jet tender, CMC zero-speed stabilisers and a Xenta joystick. US customs paid, she is lying in Miami.
